official.deadline_note: Submission is permanent (rolling); the call closes earlier once the maximum number of Visiting Student Researchers planned for each calendar year has been selected, whichever occurs first. Applications are grouped by submission date into quarterly assessment windows (first window: applications received up to 31/03/2026; second window starting 30/06/2026, and so on).
official.application_cycle: 2026-2027 round: applications opened 01 January 2026 at 09:00 and are accepted on a rolling basis with quarterly evaluation windows until 30 December 2027 at 17:00
official.status_note: FCT lists the call as open with permanent (rolling) submission of expressions of interest; up to 8 candidates are selected per calendar year.
official.tuition_coverage_note: CPS - Center for Portuguese Studies is the host institution and handles the administrative procedures for acquiring Visiting Student Researcher status, including payment of the VSPA University Services Fee, the DS-2019 (visa) Processing Fee, and the administrative fees of UC Berkeley's Institute of European Studies. FCT's programme page describes this as coverage of tuition and visa fees for 8 Portuguese doctoral students.

selection_criteria: A. Candidate's curriculum, considering academic grades, scientific track record and achievements, including peer-reviewed publications, grants, awards, conferences and participation in projects, among others (40%)
B. Scientific quality, innovative nature of the work plan and feasibility of the research activities to be developed (30%)

C. Motivation letter explaining the relevance of the stay and the work to be developed for the scientific ambition of the student's doctoral work plan, as well as the expected impact of the stay on the candidate's career (30%)
Assessment by an academic committee appointed by FCT and FLAD results in a positive or negative opinion; final classification CF = 0.4 A + 0.3 B + 0.3 C
coverage: VSPA University Services Fee - paid by CPS, the host institution
DS-2019 (visa) Processing Fee - paid by CPS
Administrative fees of UC Berkeley's Institute of European Studies - paid by CPS
Travel, accommodation and health insurance - arranged and financially supported by the selected candidates themselves

For admitted candidates already holding an FCT doctoral research fellowship: the complementary FCT supports under the Research Fellowship Regulations and the Table of Subsidies for Fellowships (2025), requested through the myFCT platform - per FCT's announcement this includes a monthly maintenance allowance abroad (where UC Berkeley is the foreign host institution), a supplementary training allowance, a single travel allowance and a single installation allowance

official.application_route: Complete the English-language expression-of-interest form linked from the call page (after securing a UC Berkeley supervisor), attaching the four required documents; no application fee.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to candidates regardless of nationality; candidates must be PhD students enrolled in Portuguese higher education institutions.
official.international_eligibility: Eligible regardless of nationality; enrolment in a Portuguese higher education institution is required.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Any scientific field; areas of mutual scientific interest between Portuguese universities and UC Berkeley.

official.description: Under the Portugal-Berkeley Program, in collaboration with FLAD and UC Berkeley, FCT launches this call for expressions of interest to support PhD students who wish to undertake a research period as visiting students at UC Berkeley. The initiative promotes the internationalisation of Portuguese science and fosters research exchanges and collaborations between Portuguese universities and UC Berkeley in areas of mutual scientific interest, supporting research stays of up to 6 months.
official.program_type: Research mobility funding - call for expressions of interest for visiting doctoral students
official.english_requirement: Applications must be submitted in English; the short CV (maximum two pages), the motivation letter and the proof of acceptance from UC Berkeley must be in English. No IELTS/TOEFL or MOI score requirement is published.

verification.notes: Checked the official FCT call page in Portuguese and English, the FCT news release (published 14/19 January 2026) and the official programme page. The call publishes no per-candidate stipend or award amount (its own statistics show total funding value of 0 euros, since CPS pays fees rather than a scholarship), so funding amount/currency/period are null.

applicant_utility.summary: This call does not pay you a scholarship: it buys the UC Berkeley side of the stay - CPS pays the Visiting Student Researcher service, visa-processing and Institute of European Studies fees - while you personally finance travel, accommodation and health insurance for up to six months. The decisive work happens before you apply, because a UC Berkeley professor must agree in writing to supervise you and arrival cannot happen until at least six months after selection, so sequence the stay around your doctoral timeline. If you already hold an FCT doctoral fellowship, the complementary supports (maintenance abroad, travel and installation allowances) exist but must be requested separately in myFCT. With only about 8 slots per calendar year, rolling quarterly windows and an early close once the quota fills, treating this as a last-minute December option is the main way to lose it.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctoral candidates enrolled at a Portuguese institution who can secure a UC Berkeley supervisor quickly and can self-fund a Bay Area stay for up to six months.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure the UC Berkeley faculty member's agreement to supervise the stay before anything else - use the model letter published on the call page
Obtain UC Berkeley's proof of acceptance in English; it is a required attachment, so start the CPS/VSR request process early
Draft the motivation letter with a concrete planned arrival date that respects the six-month post-selection rule and ties the stay to your doctoral work plan's scientific ambition
Cut the CV to two pages in English and request proof of current doctoral enrolment from your institution
If you hold an FCT PhD fellowship, file the complementary-support request in myFCT as a separate step - selection alone does not trigger it
common_rejection_risks: Applying without a confirmed Berkeley supervisor or without the English-language proof of UC Berkeley acceptance - the dossier is incomplete
A motivation letter that reads as a generic mobility wish-list; criterion C (30%) rewards a direct link to your doctoral work plan and career impact
A work plan that is ambitious but not feasible - criterion B explicitly weighs feasibility, not just innovation
Thin track record against criterion A (40%), which counts publications, conferences, prizes and project participation
Withdrawing after selection because the real cost of roughly six months in the Bay Area was never budgeted
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International travel, accommodation in the Berkeley area and US health insurance are explicitly the selected candidate's own cost, and the call provides no monthly stipend; existing FCT doctoral fellowship holders can offset this via the complementary supports claimed in myFCT (maintenance abroad, single travel allowance, single installation allowance).
document_audit: The proof of UC Berkeley acceptance must be in English - a Portuguese-language confirmation does not satisfy the rule
The CV is hard-capped at two pages, in English, so leave no room for annexes
The motivation letter must state a planned arrival date consistent with the six-month post-selection waiting rule
Proof of doctoral enrolment must evidence current enrolment at a Portuguese higher education institution
Everything travels with the single electronic form submission - there is no separate document portal, so assemble the package before opening the form
alerts: The call can close before 30 December 2027 once the annual quota of up to 8 Visiting Student Researchers is filled
Arrival at UC Berkeley cannot occur earlier than six months after selection - do not promise a supervisor or supervisor a start date inside that window
Assessment runs in quarterly windows by submission date, so a submission sent just after a window close can wait months for a verdict
No IELTS/TOEFL threshold is published, but the CV, motivation letter and acceptance proof must all be in English - get them drafted and checked well before the window you are targeting
Complementary FCT supports for existing doctoral fellows are requested separately through myFCT and are not automatic with selection
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One-shot submission of the electronic form with the four English attachments; the academic committee appointed by FCT and FLAD scores the application in the next quarterly window and issues a positive or negative opinion.
